invariants.rationale: The method always returns a newly created Map, which cannot be null.
If the result map is not empty, it must contain the key PLAN_STRATEGY_SORT_COLUMNS.key().
The map is non-empty if and only if the clustering sort columns are not null or empty.
Only one entry is ever put into the map, so the size is at most 1.
If present, the value in the result map is a non-empty string, or the map is empty.
